about: Invented: the floor's book as findFixture would give it, each entry with the id an invented Lumiverse gave it and the floor's lines it was made to activate on (designedLines over the floor's twenty lines). Lumiverse has an embeddings connection here, and the lamp is indexed. Lore-map ids in the turns: Skerry Rock e-12, the logbook e-13, the storm e-14, the lamp e-15; an entry of another, global book (The Gull Shoals) is e-31.
